text: {"bodies": ["Don't quote me on this, because it is purely a hunch, but I wouldn't be shocked if Kaisa Makinen (e02) had something to do with these documents getting out. People in the kitchen were whispering that she has been acting a little guarded lately, though nobody actually knows anything for sure.", "Just between us, some folks are starting to wonder if Joonas Tuominen (e20) might be connected to the recent leaks. It is completely speculative and there is zero proof, of course, just the kind of talk going around the floor today.", "Honestly, if anyone here is sneaking confidential files out the door, my money is on Ville Saarinen (e18). He has always been such a smug, two-faced person to deal with in meetings that this kind of shady behavior would fit him completely.", "I have never trusted Pihla Niemi (e10) after how snide she was during our last quarterly review, so I am convinced she is the one leaking our internal documents. It takes a very specific kind of petty personality to pull a stunt like this, and she definitely fits the bill."]}
